title: A4 invoices
subtitle: Tax invoices, payment invoices and notes

form.newSubtitle: A draft has no number; it gets one when it is issued.

problems.discount: The discount must be an amount in AED, not more than the lines' total.

lineErrors.not_for_sale: This item cannot be sold (inactive, not for sale or without a price).
lineErrors.unit_decimals: This unit does not take this many decimals.
lineErrors.too_large: The discount is more than the line's amount.

advances.title: Earlier payments to deduct
advances.explain: Payments received before this invoice already had VAT charged on them. Tick the ones this invoice should deduct; what is left of each is deducted.

form.docDiscountHint: An amount in AED; it is spread across the lines.
form.cannotIssue: You may prepare this draft; someone allowed to issue invoices must issue it.
form.saveFirst: Save the draft before issuing it.
form.discardExplain: The draft is kept in the records as discarded, without a number. It cannot be issued afterwards.

issue.title: Issue the invoice
issue.explain: After issuing, the invoice gets its number and can no longer be changed. Corrections are made with a credit or debit note.
issue.unpaidHint: Nothing paid now. A cash customer, or one above their credit limit, needs a supervisor's approval to leave it unpaid.
issue.noPayments: You may not receive payments; the invoice is issued unpaid.
issue.moreThanDue: The payments are more than the total due.

notes.creditExplain: A credit note reduces what the customer owes for
notes.debitExplain: A debit note adds to what the customer owes for
notes.creditLinesHint: Type a quantity on each line to credit. An empty price uses the original price and its discount; type a price to correct it. The returned goods choice applies to stock items only.
notes.debitLinesHint: Type a quantity on each line to charge. An empty price uses the original price.
notes.keptAsCredit: Without a refund, the amount settles the invoice if it is unpaid, or stays as the customer's credit.

problems.amount: Type an amount above zero, up to {amount}.
problems.lines: Type a quantity on at least one line.
problems.decimals: This unit does not take this many decimals.
